nodes.name: AudioPlayerManager.cs
nodes.summary: Archived legacy singleton audio player manager. Keeps a single AudioSource alive across scene loads via DontDestroyOnLoad and plays its clip on Start. Superseded by AudioManager in Assets/Scripts/Base Systems.
nodes.languageNotes: Classic `_instance` singleton pattern with Awake dedupe; uses UnityEngine.AudioSource directly with no pooling or fade logic.

nodes.name: AudioPlayerManager
nodes.summary: Legacy singleton MonoBehaviour that prevents duplicate instances and plays its attached AudioSource on Start.
nodes.languageNotes: Private `_instance` static field; `DontDestroyOnLoad` keeps the player alive across scenes.

nodes.name: MyDebugger.cs
nodes.summary: Archived debug helper exposing a context-menu 'Test' action that reads a serialized Tilemap's tile at a cell and prints its GameObject via TileBase.GetTileData. Reference/template code for tile data inspection.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses `[ContextMenu("Test")]` to add an editor menu item; `print()` for debug output.

nodes.name: MyDebugger
nodes.summary: MonoBehaviour with a context-menu Test method that fetches TileData from a serialized Tilemap and prints the referenced GameObject.

nodes.name: fish blitz.inputactions
nodes.summary: Unity Input System action asset defining six input maps: Player (Move, UseItem, Interact, OpenInventory, ItemSelect1-10, MoveItemCursor, OnClick, ToggleMenu, Crouch), Birding (Rotate, Move, UseBinoculars), PlayerBarrowing, Combat (UseTool), UI (Navigate/Submit/Cancel/Point/Click/etc.), and Menu (MoveCursor/ToggleMenu/Select). Binds keyboard/mouse, gamepad, touch, joystick and XR control schemes.
nodes.languageNotes: Unity Input System JSON format (version 1); actions grouped into per-context maps so HUD/birding/barrowing states can enable separate action sets.

nodes.name: DOTween.XML
nodes.summary: XML API documentation for the DOTween tweening library's DG.Tweening namespace: ~520 members covering Tween/Tweener/Sequence, DOVirtual, DOTween settings and initialization, plugins, easing, enums (Ease, LoopType, PathType, RotateMode, etc.) and Core internals.

nodes.name: DOTweenEditor.XML
nodes.summary: XML API documentation for DOTween's Unity editor tooling: EditorCompatibilityUtils, DOTweenEditorPreview (play/stop/prepare tweens in edit mode), EditorUtils (setup detection, ADB path conversion, global defines, ScriptableObject asset connection), and version helpers.

nodes.name: readme.txt
nodes.summary: DOTween package readme: upgrade instructions (reimport, reopen Unity, run Setup DOTween from Tools > Demigiant), module add/remove notes, usage (`using DG.Tweening`), and links to docs/license. Third-party library notice by Demigiant.

nodes.name: DOTweenModuleAudio.cs
nodes.summary: Third-party DOTween module adding audio tween extensions: DOFade/DOPitch on AudioSource, DOSetFloat on AudioMixer exposed floats, and operation shortcuts (DOComplete/DOKill/DOFlip/DOPlay/DOPlayBackwards/DORestart/DORewind/DOTogglePause etc.) targeting an AudioMixer.
nodes.languageNotes: Static extension class in the DG.Tweening namespace; guarded by `#if true // MODULE_MARKER`; XML doc comments on every method.

nodes.name: DOTweenModuleAudio
nodes.summary: Static class of DOTween audio shortcuts: tweens AudioSource volume/pitch and AudioMixer floats, plus AudioMixer operation shortcuts.
nodes.languageNotes: All methods are `this`-extension methods returning `TweenerCore<T, T, TOptions>` and setting the tween target for filtered operations.

nodes.name: DOTweenModuleEPOOutline.cs
nodes.summary: Third-party DOTween integration for the EPO Outline package (compiled only when the EPO_DOTWEEN define is set). Extends SerializedPass, Outlinable.OutlineProperties and Outliner with DOFloat/DOFade/DOColor/DOVector/DOBlurShift/DODilateShift and DOKill. Disabled in this project since the define is absent.
nodes.languageNotes: Wrapped in `#if false || EPO_DOTWEEN`, so the code is inert unless an optional project define is added; extension methods on third-party outline types.

nodes.name: DOTweenModuleEPOOutline
nodes.summary: Static DOTween shortcuts for EPO Outline: property tweens by name or property id on SerializedPass, color/alpha/blur/dilate tweens on outline properties and Outliners.

nodes.name: DOTweenModulePhysics.cs
nodes.summary: Third-party DOTween module for 3D physics: DOMove/DOMoveX/Y/Z, DORotate, DOLookAt, DOJump (sequence with yoyo arc), and DOPath/DOLocalPath waypoint tweens for Rigidbody.
nodes.languageNotes: Tweens write through `MovePosition`/`MoveRotation`; path tweens run on Fixed update via `SetUpdate(UpdateType.Fixed)`.

nodes.name: DOTweenModulePhysics
nodes.summary: Static class of DOTween shortcuts for Rigidbody: position/rotation/look-at tweens, jump sequence, and path tweens.

nodes.name: DOTweenModulePhysics2D.cs
nodes.summary: Third-party DOTween module for 2D physics: DOMove/DOMoveX/Y, DORotate, DOJump, and DOPath/DOLocalPath waypoint tweens for Rigidbody2D.
nodes.languageNotes: Mirrors the 3D physics module; 2D paths set `plugOptions.isRigidbody2D` and update on Fixed time.

nodes.name: DOTweenModulePhysics2D
nodes.summary: Static class of DOTween shortcuts for Rigidbody2D: move/rotate tweens, jump sequence, and path tweens.

nodes.name: DOTweenModuleSprite.cs
nodes.summary: Third-party DOTween module for SpriteRenderer: DOColor, DOFade (alpha), DOGradientColor (chained sequence), and blendable DOBlendableColor.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses `DOTween.ToAlpha` for fade and `.Blendable()` for additive color tweens.

nodes.name: DOTweenModuleSprite
nodes.summary: Static class of DOTween shortcuts for SpriteRenderer color/alpha/gradient and blendable color tweens.

nodes.name: DOTweenModuleUI.cs
nodes.summary: Third-party DOTween module for uGUI: extensions for CanvasGroup, Graphic, Image, LayoutElement, Outline, RectTransform (anchored position/anchors/pivot/sizeDelta, punch/shake/jump), ScrollRect, Slider, and Text (DOText, DOCounter), plus blendable colors, DOShapeCircle, and a Utils.SwitchToRectTransform helper.
nodes.languageNotes: Largest module (~660 lines); heavy use of chained `SetOptions(...).SetTarget(...)` and sequences for punch/shake/jump effects.

nodes.name: DOTweenModuleUI
nodes.summary: Static class of DOTween shortcuts for Unity UI components, from CanvasGroup fades to RectTransform jump/shake and Text counter tweens.

nodes.name: DOTweenModuleUnityVersion.cs
nodes.summary: Third-party DOTween module with Unity-version-gated helpers: Material gradient/offset/tiling tweens, coroutine yield instructions (WaitForCompletion/Rewind/Kill/ElapsedLoops/Position/Start via DOTweenCYInstruction), and async/await waiters for tweens.
nodes.languageNotes: Conditionally compiled with `UNITY_2018_1_OR_NEWER` and `NET_4_6 || NET_STANDARD_2_0`; defines `DOTweenCYInstruction` custom-yield classes.

nodes.name: DOTweenModuleUnityVersion
nodes.summary: Static class of Unity-version-dependent DOTween shortcuts: material gradient/offset tweens and coroutine/async waiters.

nodes.name: DOTweenCYInstruction
nodes.summary: Container of CustomYieldInstruction subclasses (WaitForCompletion, WaitForRewind, WaitForKill, WaitForElapsedLoops, WaitForPosition, WaitForStart) letting tweens be yielded from coroutines.
nodes.languageNotes: Each nested class holds a Tween reference and overrides `keepWaiting`; constructed via the WaitFor* extension methods.

nodes.name: DOTweenModuleUtils.cs
nodes.summary: Third-party DOTween utility module: reflection-driven Init (wires SetOrientationOnPath and editor playmode hook), a reflection Preserver, and a nested Physics helper (SetOrientationOnPath, HasRigidbody(2D), CreateDOTweenPathTween) that dispatches path tweens to Rigidbody, Rigidbody2D, or Transform.
nodes.languageNotes: Init called via reflection from DOTweenComponent; `[UnityEngine.Scripting.Preserve]` keeps methods from being stripped in builds.

nodes.name: DOTweenModuleUtils
nodes.summary: Static utility class handling DOTween module initialization and physics path-tween dispatch (Rigidbody/Rigidbody2D/Transform fallback).

nodes.name: AudioManager.cs
nodes.summary: Global audio service exposed as static AudioManager.Instance. PlayMusic sets a looping music clip and fades it in over 2s; PlaySFX/PlayLoopingSFX play SoundData clips with randomized volume/pitch; looping SFX re-fire with organic spacing via a coroutine and can fade in/out, returning a stop action.
nodes.languageNotes: Static singleton with `Instance` property; coroutines for fade and organic loop timing; `[SerializeField] Logger` for warnings.

nodes.name: AudioManager
nodes.summary: Singleton MonoBehaviour (AudioManager.Instance) orchestrating music, one-shot SFX, and organic looping SFX with fade/randomization.
nodes.languageNotes: All entry points are static and route through `Instance`; coroutines managed on the singleton GameObject.

nodes.name: PlayMusic
nodes.summary: Static: loads a clip on the looping music AudioSource, optionally fading in over FADE_DURATION_SECS (2s), and returns a stop action that halts the source.

nodes.name: PlaySFX
nodes.summary: Static: plays a SoundData clip once on a provided AudioSource, applying configured volume and pitch variation via Random.Range.

nodes.name: PlayLoopingSFX
nodes.summary: Static: plays a looping SoundData clip with optional fade-in and organic loop spacing (LoopWithOrganicVariation), returning a stop action that fades out or stops.

nodes.name: LoopWithOrganicVariation
nodes.summary: Coroutine that watches for clip end and replays it scheduled with random wait spacing (LoopSpacing * LoopVariationPct) and per-repeat pitch/volume variation.

nodes.name: FadeInAudio
nodes.summary: Coroutine that lerps an AudioSource volume from 0 to targetVolume over the given duration.

nodes.name: FadeOutAudio
nodes.summary: Coroutine that lerps an AudioSource volume down to 0 over the given duration then stops it.

nodes.name: Bootstrapper.cs
nodes.summary: Scene bootstrap that instantiates persistent prefabs (DontDestroyOnLoad, deduped by name), all-scene prefabs, then scene-type-specific (Inside/Outside) prefabs from a BootstrapperConfig, then destroys itself.
nodes.languageNotes: Awake-only component; uses GameObject.Find to guard against duplicate persistent instances.

nodes.name: Bootstrapper
nodes.summary: MonoBehaviour that instantiates persistent/all-scene/Inside-or-Outside prefabs from a BootstrapperConfig and then removes itself.

nodes.name: Awake
nodes.summary: Instantiates persistent prefabs, all-scene prefabs, and the scene-type-specific set, then destroys the Bootstrapper GameObject.

nodes.name: InstantiatePrefabs
nodes.summary: Instantiates each non-null prefab in the array, skipping already-present persistent ones and marking persistent instances DontDestroyOnLoad.

nodes.name: PersistentExists
nodes.summary: Static check that a prefab name or its '(Clone)' counterpart is already present in the scene, used to avoid double-spawning persistent objects.

nodes.name: DynamicPixelPerfectCamera.cs
nodes.summary: Pixel-perfect orthographic camera that follows the player, clamps within a world Collider2D bounds, recomputes ortho size when resolution changes (height-based scaling with pixelsPerUnit/scaleFactor), and forces fullscreen on start.
nodes.languageNotes: LateUpdate follow with bounds clamping; serialized pixelsPerUnit (32) and minimum height; tracks via FindGameObjectWithTag("Player").

nodes.name: DynamicPixelPerfectCamera
nodes.summary: MonoBehaviour camera controller providing pixel-perfect orthographic sizing, resolution-change handling, and player/world-bounds-follow.

nodes.name: Update
nodes.summary: Detects screen resolution changes and recomputes the camera's orthographic size via UpdateOrthoSize.

nodes.name: LateUpdate
nodes.summary: Moves the camera to the tracked player position, clamped horizontally/vertically to the world collider bounds minus camera extents.

nodes.name: UpdateOrthoSize
nodes.summary: Computes orthographic size from screen height, pixelsPerUnit and scaleFactor so the pixel grid stays aligned.

nodes.name: DynamicSpriteSorting.cs
nodes.summary: Utility that continuously sets a SpriteRenderer or SortingGroup sortingOrder from -Y position (y-sort), so sprites depth-sort by world height. Asserts one of the two components exists.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses UnityEngine.Assertions.Assert.IsTrue in Update; ordering derived from `-RoundToInt(y * 100)`.

nodes.name: DynamicSpriteSorting
nodes.summary: MonoBehaviour that y-sorts a SpriteRenderer or SortingGroup each frame based on world Y position.

nodes.name: Update
nodes.summary: Asserts a renderer exists and assigns sortingOrder = -RoundToInt(y * 100) to the SpriteRenderer or SortingGroup.

nodes.name: FloodDamage.cs
nodes.summary: On start, if WorldState.WaterState is Flood, destroys 'impermanent' child objects whose world position falls on a tile of any serialized damaged-area Tilemap, applying flood damage to the scene.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses WorldToCell + HasTile to decide which impermanent objects are submerged; reads the shared WorldState singleton.

nodes.name: FloodDamage
nodes.summary: MonoBehaviour that destroys impermanent objects standing on flood-tile tilemaps when the world is in a flood state.

nodes.name: Start
nodes.summary: Looks up the Impermanent parent and triggers DestroyDamagedObjects if the current water state is Flood.

nodes.name: DestroyDamagedObjects
nodes.summary: Destroys every impermanent child that sits on a tile of any damaged-area tilemap.

nodes.name: GameClock.cs
nodes.summary: Singleton in-game clock. Accumulates real time into game minutes (configurable day length in real minutes), derives minute/hour/day/season/year and current day period from elapsed minutes, fires OnGameMinute/Hour/Day/Season/YearTick events, supports skipping/pausing time, and exposes a GameIsPaused Reactive<bool>.
nodes.languageNotes: ReactiveUnity `Reactive<bool>` for pause state; nested DayPeriodRange/Seasons/DayPeriods enums; all time derived from a single `_gameMinutesElapsed` int.

nodes.name: GameClock
nodes.summary: Singleton MonoBehaviour (GameClock.Instance) implementing the full game time system: minutes->year derivation, day-period ranges, tick events, and pause controls.
nodes.languageNotes: Public enums Seasons/DayPeriods and ITickable interface nested inside; properties compute values lazily from `_gameMinutesElapsed`.

nodes.name: Update
nodes.summary: Accumulates Time.deltaTime and calls IncrementGameMinute each real-time second corresponding to one game minute, unless the clock is paused.

nodes.name: IncrementGameMinute
nodes.summary: Advances _gameMinutesElapsed by one and invokes minute/hour/day/season/year tick events at the appropriate boundaries.

nodes.name: InitializeClock
nodes.summary: Derives _gameMinutesElapsed from the serialized start day/hour/minute/season/year and logs the current time.

nodes.name: SkipToTime
nodes.summary: Fast-forwards the clock to a given day/hour/minute within the current season, stepping minute-by-minute so tick events fire.

nodes.name: SkipTime
nodes.summary: Advances the clock by the given number of minutes, firing tick events per minute.

nodes.name: CalculateElapsedGameMinutesSinceTime
nodes.summary: Static helper returning how many game minutes have passed since a recorded _gameMinutesElapsed snapshot.

nodes.name: PauseGame
nodes.summary: Sets GameIsPaused true and Time.timeScale to 0, guarding against double-pause.

nodes.name: ResumeGame
nodes.summary: Clears GameIsPaused and restores Time.timeScale to 1.

nodes.name: GridCursor.cs
nodes.summary: Player-facing grid cursor with 8 directional visual cursors that swap as the player's facing direction changes (subscribed via PlayerMovement.Direction OnChange). Exposes GridPosition and Collider, and provides FindObjectAtGridCursor<T> (physics overlap) and FindInteractableTileMapByTags (tagged Tilemap lookup).
nodes.languageNotes: ReactiveUnity `OnChange` subscription for direction; Assert.IsNotNull on PlayerMovement and Grid; uses Physics2D.OverlapCollider.

nodes.name: GridCursor
nodes.summary: MonoBehaviour managing the player's on-grid cursor: direction-based cursor swap, grid position/collider access, and generic lookup helpers.

nodes.name: SetCursorForPlayerDirection
nodes.summary: Swaps _activeCursor to the visual cursor matching the player's current CompassDirection (N/E/S/W plus diagonals).

nodes.name: FindObjectAtGridCursor
nodes.summary: Generic: overlaps the cursor collider with Physics2D and returns the first component of type T found, warning if several match.

nodes.name: FindInteractableTileMapByTags
nodes.summary: Searches all Tilemaps for one whose tag is in the supplied list and that has a tile at the cursor's grid position, returning the first matching tag.

nodes.name: HeatSensitive.cs
nodes.summary: Tracks ambient IHeatSource in range, gathered from serialized MonoBehaviour/ScriptableObject source lists, recomputes the hottest Temperature into a protected Reactive<Temperature>, prunes destroyed sources, and exposes Temperature via AddHeatSource/RemoveHeatSource.
nodes.languageNotes: ReactiveUnity `Reactive<Temperature>`; serialized source lists are converted to an IHeatSource working list in Awake.

nodes.name: HeatSensitive
nodes.summary: Abstract-ish MonoBehaviour (Serializable) that sums in-range IHeatSources and reports the hottest ambient Temperature, with add/remove APIs.

nodes.name: Temperature
nodes.summary: Virtual property that recomputes and returns the current hottest ambient temperature value.

nodes.name: AddHeatSource
nodes.summary: Registers an IHeatSource into the serialized lists and working list, then refreshes ambient temperature.

nodes.name: RemoveHeatSource
nodes.summary: Unregisters an IHeatSource from the lists and refreshes ambient temperature.

nodes.name: SetAmbientTemperature
nodes.summary: Protected virtual that writes the hottest source temperature into the Reactive _ambientTemperature.

nodes.name: GetTemperatureOfHottestSource
nodes.summary: Scans the working IHeatSource list, discarding nulls, and returns the numerically largest Temperature.

nodes.name: HeatSource.cs
nodes.summary: Declares the Temperature enum (Freezing, Cold, Normal, Warm, Hot — order matters as logic relies on numeric value) and the IHeatSource interface exposing a Temperature property.
nodes.languageNotes: Enum deliberately ordered cold->hot; IHeatSource implemented by both MonoBehaviours and ScriptableObjects.

nodes.name: Temperature
nodes.summary: Enum of five temperature levels ordered Freezing->Hot; numeric ordering is load-bearing for heat-source comparisons.

nodes.name: IHeatSource
nodes.summary: Interface implemented by objects that emit heat, exposing a Temperature property. Implemented by both MonoBehaviours and ScriptableObjects.

nodes.name: ISaveableComponent.cs
nodes.summary: Save contract interface: components expose a ComponentId plus CaptureStateAsJson/RestoreStateFromJson so the save system can persist their state as JSON.

nodes.name: ISaveableComponent
nodes.summary: Interface contract for JSON-serializable component state used by the scene save/load system.

nodes.name: IntroManager.cs
nodes.summary: Intro/initialization flow: resets player systems (energy/drying/temperature/strength, inventory, carry, wheelbarrow), wipes the persistent data folder, optionally plays a Narrator intro, then sets a pending spawn position (named spawn or custom) and loads the initial scene via LevelChanger.
nodes.languageNotes: Finds player managers via FindFirstObjectByType and resets them; uses a coroutine to sequence narrator messages before the scene load.

nodes.name: IntroManager
nodes.summary: MonoBehaviour that runs the game intro: state reset, save-data wipe, optional narrated opening, and initial scene spawn.

nodes.name: Awake
nodes.summary: Resets initial player state, clears saved files from persistent data path, and starts the OpeningDialogue coroutine.

nodes.name: SetInitialPlayerState
nodes.summary: Finds player energy/drying/temperature/strength managers and resets them to defaults, zeroes the active inventory slot, and clears carry/wheelbarrow state.

nodes.name: OpeningDialogue
nodes.summary: Coroutine that optionally posts narrator intro messages, waits until they clear, then loads the initial scene.

nodes.name: LoadInitialScene
nodes.summary: Sets PlayerSceneData.PendingSpawnPosition (custom or from the spawn dictionary), marks HasPendingSpawn, and calls LevelChanger.ChangeLevel.

nodes.name: ClearAllFilesInPersistentDataPath
nodes.summary: Deletes every file in Application.persistentDataPath so saves from previous runs do not carry over.

nodes.name: UnityEngine.MonoBehaviour
nodes.summary: Unity's base class for all gameplay components; referenced as the inheritance root of Fishblitz MonoBehaviour scripts.
